blurb: The city that welcomed the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, in 622, the second holiest city in Islam.

facts.t: In 622 the Prophet Muhammad and his followers left Mecca for Yathrib, which became Medinat al-Nabi, the City of the Prophet. The Islamic calendar counts its years from this journey, the Hijra.
The Prophet helped build the first mosque here with his own hands. He is buried within it, under the Green Dome. Today the mosque can hold over a million worshippers.
